_comment: The parity query set Q for the Cypher engine. The spike implements the six shapes below (design §6.1). The fuller Q1-Q16 (design §4.3) drop in here as the parser grows (variable-length, shortestPath, functions). Each query gets a golden at golden/<id>.json once captured from a pinned BHE.

queries.query: MATCH (n:User) WHERE n.hasspn = true RETURN n
MATCH (c:Computer) WHERE c.operatingsystem CONTAINS "Server" RETURN c
